pick.title: Choose a video to upload
pick.titleDesktop: Drag and drop a video here
pick.limits: Videos up to 500 MB and 3 minutes long.
pick.limitsDesktop: or choose a file from your computer. Videos up to 500 MB and 3 minutes long.

tooLarge.title: File too large
tooLarge.body: “{name}” is {size} MB. Choose a video of at most 500 MB.

notVideo.title: Not a video file
notVideo.body: “{name}” is not a video file. Choose a video.

tooLong.title: Video too long
tooLong.body: The video is {duration} long. Choose a clip of at most 3 minutes.

empty.title: Empty file
empty.body: “{name}” holds no data. Choose another video.

details.titlePlaceholder: Write a few words about your video
details.titleTooLong: The title can have at most 200 characters.

tooManyUploads.title: 3 videos are already uploading
tooManyUploads.body: You can upload at most 3 videos in 15 minutes, cancelled ones included. Wait for one to finish, then try again.

expired.title: The upload session expired
expired.body: Your file and title are kept. Press Post video to upload again with a new session.

mismatch.title: The server did not get the right file
mismatch.body: The uploaded file is missing or does not match the one you chose. Press Post video to upload it again.

rejected.title: The storage refused the file
rejected.body: Press Post video to try again. If it still fails, choose another file.

badOrigin.title: Cannot upload
badOrigin.body: The upload address does not match SVP's configuration, so the file was not sent. Try again later.

initFailed.title: The video could not be created
initFailed.body: SVP did not take the upload request. Check your connection and press Post video again.

rateLimited.title: You're going a bit fast
rateLimited.body: SVP is limiting requests from this device for now. Try again in a few minutes.

sendFailed.title: Upload failed
sendFailed.body: Three retries did not get through. Check your connection and press Retry.

completeFailed.title: The video is not confirmed yet
completeFailed.body: The file reached the server but SVP has not confirmed it. Press Retry; the file is not sent again.

cancelled.title: Upload cancelled
cancelled.body: A cancelled video still counts toward your 3 uploads in 15 minutes.

progress.label: Upload progress
progress.secondsLeft: about {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}} left
progress.minutesLeft: about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left
progress.keepOpen: Keep this page open until the upload is done. SVP then processes the video by itself.
progress.cancelNote: A cancelled video still counts toward your 3 uploads in 15 minutes.

offline.title: Connection lost
offline.body: Waiting for the network to continue.

renewed.title: The upload session expired
renewed.body: SVP opened a new session and is sending the file again from the start.

result.label: Video progress
result.processingBody: This usually takes from a few seconds to a few minutes. You can leave this page; the video shows up in My videos once it is ready.
result.readyBody: Everyone can now watch your video in Explore.
result.readyPendingBody: The video will show up in Explore.
result.failedBody: SVP could not transcode this video. Try again with another file.
